identity_policy: Verify all original numerical-module hashes and immutable parent evidence. Allow only the explicitly named new resume adapter as an added source module. Preserve saved trial costs, survivor order, RNG state and all non-budget settings.
stopping_application: Diagnostic only. Complete the fixed total budget and audit any early provisional suggestion using later windows; do not reset patience at the checkpoint boundary.

selection.source: Pooled feasible nondominated calibration archive from both 256-attempt seed histories.
selection.baseline: Retain original generalized trial as comparison; do not reevaluate it within the continuation search budget.
selection.balanced: Existing Pareto-range-scaled distance to calibration ideal with deterministic objective and pooled-ID tie breaking.
selection.origin_tracking: Preserve the pilot's pooled IDs 0-255 for both inherited prefixes. Append seed42 new trials as IDs256-383 and seed43 new trials as IDs384-511. Track source seed/local evaluation ID as primary provenance.
selection.validation_use: Held-out reporting after selected identities/vectors are frozen; never alter search, stopping or selection from validation results.

next_budget_rule.if_either_seed_unstable_or_pairwise_fron: Recommend a further calibration-only budget experiment, potentially 512 total attempts per seed, using verified continuation; do not declare convergence.
next_budget_rule.if_both_have_sustained_stopping_candidat: Recommend a planned third seed and extension audit before stronger reproducibility claims.
next_budget_rule.high_rejection_handling: Review reported failure reasons before increasing budget; do not relax the frozen source or strict-root policies based on performance.

scope: Only 128 additional search evaluations per seed. Keep source policy, physics, 72-coordinate bounds and nominal provisional anchors fixed. Reporting replays are counted separately.
